ex.s: For instance, you might hear someone say: “It’s cold this winter, so I needn’t worry about global warming.”Another is that loud and urgent matters are given too much importance, making people ignore longer-term trends that arguably matter more.
ex.t: 比如,你可能听到有人说 : “ 今年冬天很寒冷,所以我不必担心全球变暖。 ”另外一点是,响亮而紧迫的问题被赋予了太多的重要性,使人们忽略了长期趋势,而长期趋势可能更重要。

ex.s: Now a team of researchers led by Damián Blasi at the University of Zurich, Switzerland, has found how and why this trend arose.
ex.t: 现在,由瑞士苏黎世大学的达米安·布拉西(Damián Blasi)率领的一组研究人员已经发现了这一趋势是如何出现的,也是为什么出现的。

ex.s: In the past few years, an increasing number of people and organisations have begun coming up with plans to counter this trend.
ex.t: 在过去几年里,越来越多的人和组织开始制订计划来扭转这一趋势。

ex.s: Collapseology, the study of collapse, is more concerned with identifying trends and with them the dangers of everyday civilization.
ex.t: 折叠学,即对崩塌的研究,更关注于辨别趋势,以及这些趋势对日常文明的危害.

ex.s: There has been a recent trend in the food service industry toward lower fat content and less salt.
ex.t: 食品服务行业最近出现了降低脂肪含量和盐量的趋势。

ex.s: In southern Spain the sudden increase of greenhouses (which reflect light back to space) has changed the warming trend locally, and actually cooled the region.
ex.t: 在西班牙南部,温室的突然增加(这反映光回到太空)改变了当地变暖的趋势,实际上使该地区降温.

ex.s: If current trends don’t bend, Russia’s population will be about the size of Yemen’s by the year 2050.
ex.t: 如果目前的趋势不改变，到2050年，俄罗斯的人口规模将与也门相当。

ex.t: 这些数字听起来可能很小，但它们是危险趋势的前沿。
